parent_objective: audit the full 12-profile three-seed public go/no-go matrix before any further standard-profile scaling
blocked_by: M1497 is a public trend pilot and cannot support private-holdout promotion, profile superiority, or level3 self-identification claims
supersedes: another standard fixed-budget profile pilot without stop-rule audit

public_gates: M1498 must audit M1497 before any further standard-profile scaling
M1498 must evaluate the M1496 stop rule
M1498 must separate public trend evidence from paper-level and private-holdout evidence
M1498 must block promotion, private holdout, profile-specific tuning, corpus export, and self-ID claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat M1497 as architecture ranking
do not continue standard profile pilots if the stop rule is triggered

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits the full 12-profile three-seed public pilot and decides whether the standard-profile branch should continue
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit and branch-routing only; no training, PPO, replay, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if audit treats M1497 as private-holdout evidence
stop if audit treats M1497 as profile superiority proof
stop if audit ignores L2 current-tiled controls
stop if audit ignores L3 online versus corrected reset-control
fallback_plan: pivot to decisive T4/T5 task evidence if standard profile scaling is negative or conditional
route to L3 recipe repair only if the audit finds implementation or optimization evidence explaining L3 underperformance
record a negative or conditional standard-distribution verdict if neither branch is justified
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1496 stop rule and M1497 three-seed pilot completion

admission_evidence: M1497 completed 36 of 36 profile seed runs with finite metrics
M1497 did not use private holdout, promotion, profile-specific tuning, or actor-input changes
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1498 audits M1497 L2 current-tiled and L3 reset controls and must not convert public trends into self-ID claims.
history_necessity_tests: audit L2 normal versus current-tiled three-seed trends
audit L3 online versus corrected reset-control three-seed trends
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: three fixed-budget public seeds per profile.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If current-tiled controls remain close and L3 online does not beat reset, stop standard profile scaling and route to decisive-task evidence, L3 recipe repair, or a negative/conditional standard-distribution verdict.
allowed_claims: no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1497 should be audited as a clean public profile pilot whose trends trigger the M1496 stop rule before any further standard-profile scaling.
success_criteria: audit records M1497 completion and finite metrics
audit records L2 normal/current-tiled three-seed trend
audit records L3 online/reset three-seed trend
audit evaluates the M1496 stop rule
audit blocks promotion private holdout profile ranking corpus export and self-ID claims
audit routes to a clear next branch
failure_criteria: audit treats M1497 public trends as profile ranking
audit starts training replay PPO promotion private holdout corpus export or actor-input change
decision_rule: M1498 passes if it audits M1497 and routes the standard-profile branch without overclaiming public trends.
